summary: Run115 product packed weights have 8MiB W1 + 4MiB W2 per expert; Run121 active expert-layer pairs median 672.5 per rank-cycle gives conditional packed footprint 7.881GiB. Against Run107 GMM median 9.966ms this implies ~849GB/s if each active weight were loaded once. Different cohorts and no memory counters mean this is diagnostic, not a hardware bound. GMM1 skips zero-M in source; GMM2 calls torch_npu grouped matmul. Next capture actual counters.
